params.swWiring: pressed connects SW to GND, released leaves SW floating

provenance.notes: KIT: no joystick lesson or part in the SunFounder Basic Starter Kit table of contents or Component List photo, so 'not in kit'. PIN ORDER: the SunFounder module photo (09_joystick.png) shows a 5-pin male header printed GND, +5V, VRX, VRY, SW from top to bottom. SCHEMATIC: the SunFounder schematic (09_joystick_schematic.png) shows two potentiometers each wired between +5V (VCC) and GND with wipers VRX and VRY, and the push switch wired from SW to GND with no resistor on SW; the photo shows an empty pad labelled R1 (unpopulated pull-up position). The SunFounder page says 'The pushbutton switch outputs a floating signal by default' and 'a pull-up resistor is needed', so swOnBoardPullup is false: the reader must enable a pull-up. SUPPLY CONFLICT: SunFounder says 'Supply Voltage: 3.3V or 5V' and prints +5V on the pin; the Joy-IT KY-023 datasheet says 'Operating voltage 3.3 V' and 'Voltage range (output) 0 - 5V'; the range 3.3-5 V is used. The analog outputs span 0 V to the supply (SunFounder 'changes from 0 to VCC', about half of VCC at rest), so at 5 V supply VRX and VRY reach 5 V and need a divider before a 3.3 V GPIO or ADC input. SIZE CONFLICT: SunFounder gives PCB 34 x 26 mm; the Joy-IT datasheet gives 34 x 39 x 26 mm (order unclear); reseller listings seen in a search (not opened) give 34 x 26 x 32 mm; the 32 mm height is used. Mounting hole spans are measured from the SunFounder photo using the 34 mm board length as the scale (+-0.5 mm). NOT VERIFIED: the potentiometer resistance (reseller text says 10 kOhm per axis; no opened datasheet states it), so it is not recorded in sim params.
